# Keyed map carrier relations

Independently authored Java8 methods bind one collection element to the input
of two mapping functions. The two outputs occupy ordered slots of a complete
Map result, including nested invariant Map/List carriers. Original opaque
provider actions, callback order, exact references, failures and delayed casts
are observed without predicting what a provider must return. The SDK profile
keeps only the original caller in DEX. All recovered units compile; original
Signatures, roles, Exceptions and reported helpers are checked independently.
